svg.title: Comparing only the power associated with a zero boundary

cc:Work.dc:title: Comparing only the power associated with a zero boundary
cc:Work.dc:description: Original log-log teaching plot of x^(beta-1) for beta=11/12, 7/8 and 1/2 over x from 10^2 to 10^24. Not a complete error bound for pi or psi; constants, logs, epsilon and zero-height contributions are omitted. The 1/2 line is hypothetical.
